kebab_example: aliyun dm sender-statistics-detail-by-param --account-name s000@example.net --to-address b000@example.net --status 0 --start-time 2021-04-28_00:00 --end-time 2021-04-29_00:00 --tag-name EmailQuestionnaireHelioscam --length 5 --next-start '90f0243616#203#a000@example.net-1658817837#a000@example.net.247475288187' --ip-pool-id e42a4d8e-66e0-4ea3-88aa-74c66c661cef --config-set-id 95437e39-5433-4c6c-8b66-0c4eac2f4d97 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SenderStatisticsDetailByParam

parameters.help_en:
The sender address. If you leave this parameter empty, emails from all sender addresses are queried.

You can leave AccountName, TagName, and ToAddress empty. You can specify a value for only one of these parameters at a time
parameters.help_zh:
发信地址。不填，代表所有地址。

AccountName、TagName、ToAddress可以都不填写。若填写，只能传递其中一个参数，不能同时传递两个或以上组合的参数
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The recipient address. If you leave this parameter empty, emails sent to all recipient addresses are queried
parameters.help_zh: 收信地址。不填，代表所有收信地址
parameters.name: to_address

parameters.help_en:
The delivery status. If you leave this parameter empty, emails in all delivery statuses are queried. Valid values:

0: delivered successfully

2: invalid address

3: spam

4: failed
parameters.help_zh:
投递结果。不填，代表所有状态。取值：

0：成功
2：无效地址
3：垃圾邮件
4：失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The start time. The time range between the start time and the end time cannot exceed 30 days. The format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间，和结束时间跨度不能超出30天，格式yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The time range between the start time and the end time cannot exceed 30 days. The format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，和起始时间跨度不能超出30天, 格式yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The email tag. If you leave this parameter empty, emails with all tags are queried.
When you send an email using SMTP, specify the \`TagName\` and its value for the \`X-AliDM-Trace\` field. For more information, see the examples for email tracking
parameters.help_zh:
邮件标签。不填，代表所有标签。
SMTP发信时，请参考邮件跟踪示例，对“X-AliDM-Trace”字段，指定标签字段"TagName"和对应值
parameters.name: tag_name

parameters.help_en: The number of results to return. The value can range from 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定本次请求返回结果数目。范围是1~100
parameters.name: length

parameters.help_en: The offset for this request, used for paging. If more results are available, set the \`NextStart\` parameter in your next request to this return value
parameters.help_zh: 分页用，指定本次请求的偏移量。如果还有更多结果，下次请求将该返回值设置到请求中的NextStart
parameters.name: next_start

parameters.help_en: The ID of the independent IP address pool
parameters.name: ip_pool_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the configuration set
parameters.name: config_set_id

NextStart.description_en: Used for paging. If more results are available, set the \`NextStart\` parameter in your next request to this return value
NextStart.description_zh: 分页使用。如果还有更多结果，下次请求将该返回值设置到请求中的NextStart

ConfigSetId.description_en: The ID of the configuration set

ConfigSetName.description_en: The name of the configuration set

ErrorClassification.description_en:
The detailed classification of the error:

SendOk: The email was delivered successfully.

SmtpNxBox: The recipient's email server determined that the address is invalid. The address is added to the invalid address list of your account.

SysOutRcptOnAccountLevelBounceList: The recipient address is in the invalid address list for your account. If you confirm that the address is valid, remove it from the list. You can also disable the invalid address list for your account.

For more information about error descriptions, see [Explanations of common failed_type values]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52048.html）
ErrorClassification.description_zh:
错误原因的详细分类：
SendOk：投递成功

SmtpNxBox：收信系统认定为无效地址，会进入您的账号级别无效地址库。

SysOutRcptOnAccountLevelBounceList：命中账号级别无效地址库，如您确认该地址有效，可在无效地址库页面进行删除，或选择不启用账号级别无效地址库。

更多错误描述请参考[关于常见failed_type的解释]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52048.html）

IpPoolId.description_en: The ID of the independent IP address pool

IpPoolName.description_en: The name of the independent IP address pool

LastUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the status was last updated
LastUpdateTime.description_zh: 更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 UTC 时间格式，精确到分钟

Message.description_en: The detailed information about the delivery

Status.description_en: The delivery status. 0: delivered successfully, 2: invalid address, 3: spam, 4: failed for other reasons
Status.description_zh: 投递状态：0 成功，2 无效地址，3 垃圾邮件，4 其余失败

UtcLastUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the status was last updated, in UTC format
